senses.en_definition: For; intended for a particular purpose, use, or recipient.
For; from the perspective of a particular person or group.
To give or hand something to someone (colloquial).
To let or allow someone to do something.
To divide something into parts or shares.

messages.en: My phone still won't connect to Wi-Fi. I've tried all sorts of things already.
When we meet up later, let me have a go first. I've watched a video on how to fix it.
Sure, I'll bring the phone along later. Hopefully we can get it working this time.

senses.en_definition: Good; of a high or satisfactory standard.
Very beautiful or handsome in appearance.
An exclamation expressing praise, approval, or satisfaction.

messages.en: The slides for tomorrow are ready. I've sent them to you—could you give them a quick check?
Great! You've finished early. I'll check them now, and then you can take a break.

collocations.en: It's good to hear you're well again.

messages.en: That's great! Want to go out for a meal later?

senses.en_definition: Happy and contented; enjoying peace and well-being.
Fortunate; blessed with good fortune, especially in wishes for someone's future.

collocations.en: may happiness and good fortune be yours
enjoy happiness and good fortune in the future

messages.en: Oh, you're married! Congratulations! Wishing you a lifetime of happiness together!
Thanks! We only got married last week. Come over sometime and we'll have a meal together.
